name: io.github.darkmatter-hub/verifiable-agent-audit-trail
title: DarkMatter
description: Tamper-evident records of AI agent decisions. Verify offline, or publish a proof link.

environmentVariables.name: DARKMATTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Publishes each record to DarkMatter and returns a verification URL. Without it, records stay on local disk and verify offline.

environmentVariables.name: DARKMATTER_SHARE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 'true' to make published records readable by anyone holding the link. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: DARKMATTER_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Override the API host. Defaults to https://darkmatterhub.ai.

environmentVariables.name: DARKMATTER_MCP_STORE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Directory for local record storage.
